mapper.select: select d.doc_id, d.title, d.content, d.vector_status, d.create_time, d.update_time from knowledge_doc d where d.owner_id = #{ownerId} and d.system_type = 'PREFERENCE' order by d.doc_id asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_doc (doc_id, title, stage, knowledge_point_id, owner_id, difficulty, data_type, content, source_type, vector_status, chunk_count, status, folder_id, system_type, create_time) values (#{docId}, #{title}, #{stage}, '', #{ownerId}, 1, 'KNOWLEDGE', #{content}, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, 'PREFERENCE', now())
mapper.update: update knowledge_doc set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, update_time = now() where doc_id = #{docId} and system_type = 'PREFERENCE'
mapper.select: select count(1) from knowledge_doc d where d.doc_id = #{docId} and d.owner_id = #{ownerId} and d.system_type = 'PREFERENCE'
